  "explanation": "Partial sums of δ,2δ,4δ,…,2^nδ are δ,3δ,7δ,…,(2^j−1)δ, so the parenthetical \"marks are 2^j δ\" is indeed a misprint (only j=1 coincides). But the lower bound never uses the mark coordinates: display (9) fixes the interval lengths δ,2δ,…,2^nδ, binary uniqueness gives Γ=δ, and the refinement lemma's lower half yields D≥δ against every Xiang reply with ≤n cuts. The marks are plainly distinct interior points for these lengths. Hence L3.3 stands; only the symbol 2^j needs to become 2^j−1."
